interpretation: All four branches and evaluation completed without retries. Learned exits beat calibrated matched-random exits in held-out loss, but skip only about 0.4% to 1.6% of middle computation steps. All selected policies are slower than their own full-depth controls; no practical gate passes. Random-STOP adaptation improves early-exit robustness but worsens full-depth quality. Single-pair pilot; not a claim about all early-exit methods.
